rationale: The agent authenticated the user via matching email, retrieved the user’s orders, correctly identified the fleece jacket in a pending order, and accurately stated that exchanges can only be processed for delivered orders. The agent offered an appropriate alternative (modifying the pending order) and, after the user chose to wait, did not perform any unauthorized changes. No fabricated information or policy violations occurred. While the exchange was not completed due to order status, the agent followed policy and handled the request appropriately.
